caseName: Theoharous v. Deer Run Shores Property Owners Ass'n
caseNameFull: Theoharous v. Deer Run Shores Property Owners Assn., Inc.

opinions.text: Appeal from Super. Ct. Conn., Small Claims Sess., dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
